name: Ghostbusters Firehouse (Hook & Ladder 8, 14 N Moore St) as in Ghostbusters (1984)
frame: glTF metres, +Y up. Front (N Moore St) faces +Z, Varick St side faces +X. Origin = front-centre of the whole lot (city mapdef FIREHOUSE box, 16 x 30 m) at sidewalk-top level (y=0 = garage floor = sidewalk top). The real-width firehouse (8.6 m, as in the film) stands on the Varick corner of the lot (x 3.7 +- 4.3); the rest of the lot (x -8 .. -0.6) is the 5-storey neighbour loft, part of this GLB. Node Building is translated +3.7 m in x; all empties below are given in the root (lot) frame.

anchor.note: src/city/mapdef.js FIREHOUSE box [-31, -40.5, -15, -10.5], frontDir [0, 1]: root at the lot front-centre on the N Moore St property line, y = sidewalk top (SIDEWALK_H 0.15)

driveway.note: kerb cut in front of the arch (world x); the arch is 3.5 m wide, centred at world x -19.3

integration.ground: The GLB brings its own garage floor at y = 0 (sidewalk top) and a basement stair hole: the city must draw no lot/sidewalk surface and build no ground collider inside the lot footprint (world x -31..-15, z -40.5..-10.5; the firehouse part is world x -23.6..-15), otherwise the garage floor z-fights and the basement stair is capped.
integration.materials: Do not patch materials whose name contains Emit; DoorGlassEmit (garage door panes + fanlight) is meant to be emissive only, give it envMapIntensity 0 if a scene.environment is set.
integration.signs: X_SignEmit = lit No-Ghost lightbox (setSign), X_WinEmit = lit upper-floor windows (warm room cell), DoorGlassEmit = garage glass (setGarageGlow, ~0.07..0.3).

groups.Exterior: facades, cornices, windows (opaque night glass), roof, signs (SignEmit = lit No-Ghost lightbox, GHOSTBUSTERS board), bollards. Always visible. LOD: whole exterior is ~11362 tris.
groups.Interior_Garage: ground floor hall: Ecto bay, Janine, pole, stairs, columns, tin ceiling. Show when the camera is inside, or outside within ~60 m in front (+Z half-space) while a garage door is open.
groups.Interior_Upper: upper floor: bunk room + pole hole, office, Egon lab. Show only when the camera is inside the footprint.
groups.Interior_Basement: basement with the ECU. Show only when the camera is inside and below y=1.5 or in the rear (z < -15).
groups.Colliders: hidden convex hulls (Collider_*), <= 8-20 vertices each; build fixed Rapier convex hulls in the landmark frame. Door colliders are children of the door nodes (kinematic).

bakedLighting.attribute: COLOR_0 on meshes that carry a _TINT attribute (Garage_Mesh, Upper_Mesh, Basement_Mesh, ECU_Body, ECU_Lever_Mesh, ECU_SlotDoor_Mesh; materials I_*)
bakedLighting.meaning: B = COLOR_0.rgb * 8 multiplies the albedo (outgoing = albedo * B, i.e. three.js irradiance = PI * B). Use src/landmarks/index.js (patchBaked) which turns COLOR_0 into indirect irradiance instead of a base colour multiply; dynamic lights still add on top.
bakedLighting.practicals: garage: 5 globe pendants (GlobeEmit), Janine desk lamp; upper: 3 ceiling globes, office desk lamp, 2 fluorescent fixtures (TubeEmit) in the lab; basement: 2 fluorescent fixtures, monitor cabinet green lights. All baked; no real lights needed.

GarageDoor_L.note: swing door leaf in the arch, hinged at the west jamb; positive rotation about +Y swings it inward (toward -Z)

GarageDoor_R.note: east leaf, negative rotation swings it inward

doors.fixed_transom: arched glazed fanlight above the leaves (DoorGlassEmit glows from inside, emissiveIntensity 0..2)

pole.note: slide: feet from PoleTop (upper floor level) to PoleBottom (garage floor) along the brass pole axis, body offset ~0.3 m from the axis; enter from PoleEntry (gap in the brass guard rail, facing the pole); land facing PoleExit. Floor hole radius 0.42 m.

ECU.note: Ecto Containment Unit on the basement front wall; ECU local +Z = out of the cabinet toward the player, +X = viewer's right

ECU_Slot.note: trap root pose when fully inserted (trap origin bottom-centre, trap front +Z points into the cabinet)

ECU_SlotOut.note: trap pose at the slot mouth before sliding in (same orientation); slide 0.6 m along ECU -Z

ECU_SlotDoor.note: flap hinged at its bottom edge; positive rotation about local +X drops it outward/down

ECU_Lever.note: red-handled lever on the right of the slot; rotate about local +X from rest (-12, pointing up) to pulled (+115, pointing down toward the player)

map.0: red: caged lamp left + red indicator
map.1: green: caged lamp right + green indicator

ECU_LightEmit.note: lens colours come from the emissive map (palette), drive with src/engine/segments.js segmentize(): set levels[0]=1 for red, levels[1]=1 for green

ECU_DoorEmit.note: glow around the slot door and inside the slot; ramp emissiveIntensity 0..4 while sealing

ECU_Light.note: optional: a single real PointLight here (red/green, ~6 cd, range 6 m) while the lights flash

JanineSeat.note: Janine hips pose: seat surface centre at 0.47 m, facing +X (her desk, phone and computer)

EctoBay.note: Ecto-1 root pose when parked (car front +Z toward the garage door)

PlayerSpawn.note: player root pose inside the garage, left of the car behind the pole, facing the garage doors

BasementStairTop.note: top of the steel basement stair (garage rear)

GarageDoorOutside.note: just outside the arch on the sidewalk, facing the doors

PoleTop.note: pole axis at upper floor level

PoleEntry.note: player stands here (upper floor) facing the pole to grab it

StairTop.note: top of the main stair (upper floor)

UpgradeBench.note: player root pose at Egon's lab bench (upgrade shop), facing the bench (+X)

ECU_Front.note: player root pose in front of the ECU, facing it

colliders.note: convex hulls; Collider_GarageDoor_L/R are children of the door nodes

audio_emitters.AlarmBell: the brass fire alarm bell on the wall behind Janine (ring when a call comes in)
audio_emitters.ECU: containment unit hum, insert, lever, seal
